"""冻结代码上的全量检查，保存返回码与原始UTF-8输出。"""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path.cwd()
HEAD = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']).decode().strip()
OUT = ROOT / '.local' / ('round7-validation-' + HEAD[:7])
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
env = os.environ.copy()
env['PATH'] = str(Path.home() / '.cargo/bin') + os.pathsep + env['PATH']
env['PYTHONUTF8'] = '1'
env['PYTHONIOENCODING'] = 'utf-8'
cargo = str(Path.home() / '.cargo/bin/cargo.exe')
commands = [
    [str(Path.home() / '.cargo/bin/rustc.exe'), '--version'], [cargo, 'fetch', '--locked'],
    [cargo, 'build', '--workspace', '--locked', '--offline'],
    [cargo, 'fmt', '--all', '--check'],
    [cargo, 'clippy', '--workspace', '--all-targets', '--locked', '--offline', '--', '-D', 'warnings'],
    [cargo, 'test', '--workspace', '--all-targets', '--locked', '--offline'],
    [cargo, 'test', '--workspace', '--doc', '--locked', '--offline'],
    [sys.executable, '-X', 'utf8', 'scripts/check_workspace.py'],
    [sys.executable, '-X', 'utf8', '-m', 'unittest', 'discover', '-s', 'tests', '-p', 'test_*.py', '-v'],
    [cargo, 'build', '--workspace', '--release', '--locked', '--offline'],
    ['git', 'diff', '--check'],
]
report = {'implementation_commit': HEAD, 'checked_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
          'runner_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'checks': []}
for index, command in enumerate(commands, 1):
    start = time.perf_counter()
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    stdout = OUT / f'check-{index:02}-stdout.txt'
    stderr = OUT / f'check-{index:02}-stderr.txt'
    stdout.write_bytes(result.stdout)
    stderr.write_bytes(result.stderr)
    row = {'command': command, 'returncode': result.returncode, 'seconds': time.perf_counter() - start,
           'stdout_file': stdout.name, 'stdout_sha256': hashlib.sha256(result.stdout).hexdigest(),
           'stderr_file': stderr.name, 'stderr_sha256': hashlib.sha256(result.stderr).hexdigest()}
    report['checks'].append(row)
    (OUT / 'checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
    print(json.dumps({'check': index, 'returncode': result.returncode, 'seconds': row['seconds']}), flush=True)
    if result.returncode:
        raise SystemExit(result.returncode)

"""精确归档的来源矩阵双构建、实际拒绝门禁和旧正式包只读核对。"""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import zipfile

ROOT = Path.cwd()
HEAD = 'e96ed5dc96c6cc0446f3446838fab9305047c1bc'
OUT = ROOT / '.local/round7-diagnostics-e96ed5d'
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
env = os.environ.copy()
env['PYTHONUTF8'] = '1'
env['PYTHONIOENCODING'] = 'utf-8'
archive = OUT / 'source.zip'
subprocess.run(['git', 'archive', '--format=zip', '--output=' + str(archive), HEAD], check=True)
checkout = OUT / 'checkout'
checkout.mkdir()
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as package:
    package.extractall(checkout)
isolated = [sys.executable, '-I', '-X', 'utf8', '-c',
            'import sys,runpy;sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv.pop(1));runpy.run_module(sys.argv.pop(1),run_name="__main__")', str(checkout)]
commands = [
    ('source-matrix-a', isolated + ['tools.data_pipeline.source_review', '--root', str(checkout), '--output', str(OUT / 'matrix-a.json')], 0),
    ('source-matrix-b', isolated + ['tools.data_pipeline.source_review', '--root', str(checkout), '--output', str(OUT / 'matrix-b.json')], 0),
    ('pending-audit', isolated + ['tools.data_pipeline.annotation_workflow', '--packet', str(checkout / 'data/plans/ime-annotation-round6.json'), '--output', str(OUT / 'pending-audit.json')], 2),
    ('pending-freeze', isolated + ['tools.data_pipeline.annotation_workflow', '--packet', str(checkout / 'data/plans/ime-annotation-round6.json'), '--freeze', '--output', str(OUT / 'pending-freeze')], 1),
    ('wikipedia-gate', isolated + ['tools.data_pipeline.corpus_gate', '--revision', str(ROOT / '.local/round6-wikipedia-acquisition/revision.utf8'), '--page-id', '342', '--revision-id', '94816134', '--output', str(OUT / 'wikipedia-gate.json')], 2),
    ('old-package-verify', isolated + ['tools.data_pipeline', 'verify', str(ROOT / '.local/round5-clean-6d3d4e1/release-a')], 0),
]
result = {'implementation_commit': HEAD, 'checked_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
          'runner_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'checks': []}
for name, command, expected in commands:
    start = time.perf_counter()
    run = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    row = {'name': name, 'command': command, 'returncode': run.returncode, 'expected_returncode': expected,
           'seconds': time.perf_counter() - start, 'stdout': run.stdout.decode('utf-8'), 'stderr': run.stderr.decode('utf-8')}
    result['checks'].append(row)
    (OUT / 'diagnostics.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
    print(json.dumps({'name': name, 'returncode': run.returncode, 'expected': expected}), flush=True)
    if run.returncode != expected:
        raise SystemExit(1)


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


assert (OUT / 'matrix-a.json').read_bytes() == (OUT / 'matrix-b.json').read_bytes()
matrix = json.loads((OUT / 'matrix-a.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert len(matrix['sources']) == 9 and not matrix['creates_new_source_approval']
assert not (OUT / 'pending-freeze').exists()
pending = json.loads((checkout / 'data/plans/ime-annotation-round6.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert len(pending['tasks']) == 12 and all(task['status'] == 'pending' for task in pending['tasks'])
old_identity = json.loads((ROOT / 'docs/reports/cl009/round6/identity.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
old_folder = ROOT / '.local/round5-clean-6d3d4e1/release-a'
old_hashes = {path.name: sha(path) for path in old_folder.iterdir()}
assert old_hashes == old_identity['old_package_files']
protected = ['crates', 'apps', 'tools/data_pipeline/pipeline.py', 'tools/data_pipeline/recovery.py',
             'tools/data_pipeline/word_source.py', 'tools/data_pipeline/linguistic_sidecar.py',
             'tools/data_pipeline/cedict_source.py', 'tools/data_pipeline/filesystem.py', 'data/plans/ime-annotation-round6.json']
unchanged = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--name-only', '52619a9', HEAD, '--', *protected]).decode().splitlines()
assert not unchanged
identity = {'implementation_commit': HEAD, 'archive_sha256': sha(archive),
            'matrix_double_build_identical': True, 'matrix_bytes': (OUT / 'matrix-a.json').stat().st_size,
            'matrix_sha256': sha(OUT / 'matrix-a.json'), 'matrix_sources': len(matrix['sources']),
            'old_package_files': old_hashes, 'protected_production_changes': unchanged,
            'pending_tasks': len(pending['tasks']), 'language_metrics': {'top1': None, 'top5': None, 'mrr': None},
            'real_human_gold_delivered': False, 'formal_semantic_sidecar_delivered': False,
            'tool_files_sha256': {path.name: sha(path) for path in sorted((checkout / 'tools/data_pipeline').glob('*.py'))},
            'python_executable_sha256': sha(Path(sys.executable)),
            'release_core_binary_sha256': sha(ROOT / 'target/release/cloudleaf-cli.exe'),
            'resource_or_performance_acceptance_measured': False}
(OUT / 'identity.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
print(json.dumps({'matrix_double_build_identical': True, 'archive_sha256': identity['archive_sha256'],
                  'matrix_sha256': identity['matrix_sha256'], 'old_files_unchanged': len(old_hashes)}), flush=True)

"""归档Round7原始UTF-8日志与固定产物，既有报告不覆盖。"""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

ROOT = Path.cwd()
OUT = ROOT / 'docs/reports/cl009/round7'
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
RAW = {}
FILES = {}


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def save(name, value):
    path = OUT / name
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')


def publish(source, name):
    data = source.read_bytes()
    raw = data.decode('utf-8')
    RAW[name] = {'original_path': str(source), 'sha256': sha(data), 'bytes': len(data), 'utf8': raw}
    path = OUT / name
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if source.suffix == '.json':
        save(name, json.loads(raw))
    else:
        display = '\n'.join(line.rstrip() for line in raw.splitlines()).rstrip()
        path.write_text(display + ('\n' if display else ''), encoding='utf-8', newline='\n')
    FILES[name] = {'original_sha256': sha(data), 'published_sha256': sha(path.read_bytes())}


for path in sorted((ROOT / '.local/round7-validation-e96ed5d').iterdir()):
    publish(path, 'validation/' + path.name)
for name in ['diagnostics.json', 'identity.json', 'matrix-a.json', 'matrix-b.json', 'pending-audit.json', 'wikipedia-gate.json']:
    publish(ROOT / '.local/round7-diagnostics-e96ed5d' / name, name)
for folder in ['round7-red', 'round7-matrix-red']:
    for path in sorted((ROOT / '.local' / folder).iterdir()):
        publish(path, 'red/' + folder + '/' + path.name)
baseline = '52619a963070cd74c53d0b8d76fc40bf5b7a8327'
implementation = 'e96ed5dc96c6cc0446f3446838fab9305047c1bc'
history = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', baseline, 'docs/reports']).decode().splitlines()
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--name-only', baseline, '--', *history])
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--diff-filter=D', '--name-only', baseline, '--', 'tests', 'crates'])
save('history-integrity.json', {'baseline': baseline, 'implementation_commit': implementation,
     'historical_reports_unchanged': len(history), 'old_tests_deleted': [],
     'production_core_and_release_changes': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', '--name-only', baseline, implementation, '--',
         'crates', 'apps', 'tools/data_pipeline/pipeline.py', 'tools/data_pipeline/recovery.py',
         'tools/data_pipeline/word_source.py', 'tools/data_pipeline/linguistic_sidecar.py',
         'tools/data_pipeline/cedict_source.py', 'tools/data_pipeline/filesystem.py']).decode().splitlines()})
save('raw-artifacts.json', {'encoding': 'UTF-8; utf8.encode reconstructs exact original bytes', 'files': RAW})
save('provenance.json', {'implementation_commit': implementation, 'published_at_utc': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
     'files': FILES, 'scope': 'No acquired source body, new permission, human gold or production semantic sidecar',
     'tool_files_sha256': {p.name: sha(p.read_bytes()) for p in sorted((ROOT / 'tools/data_pipeline').glob('*.py'))},
     'pending_tasks_sha256': sha((ROOT / 'data/plans/ime-annotation-round6.json').read_bytes())})
save('runners.json', {'sources': [{'name': name, 'sha256': sha((ROOT / '.local' / name).read_bytes()),
                                 'utf8': (ROOT / '.local' / name).read_bytes().decode('utf-8')}
                                for name in ['run_round7_data_checks.py', 'run_round7_data_diagnostics.py', 'publish_round7_data.py']]})
save('checksums.json', {'scope': 'Git LF publication bytes; excludes checksum manifest itself',
     'files': {path.relative_to(OUT).as_posix(): sha(path.read_bytes()) for path in sorted(OUT.rglob('*')) if path.is_file()}})
print(json.dumps({'original_files': len(RAW), 'historical_reports_unchanged': len(history), 'published': str(OUT)}))
